title: Band breaks up; Chinese restaurant job in Flint
summary: After the band broke, Roy and Joe worked a restaurant job in Flint, and Roy fed the destitute former bandleader.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Then the band broke up. Teddy went to Toledo, and from Toledo he went to Chicago, you know. The cats went different ways, you know. So me and my brother got a job in a Chinese place in Flint. Well, the bread wasn't too good, but we wanted to eat, you know. And this cat came through there, that brother that broke up. And he was destitute. He was hungry; he didn't have no money. I never told him about the misery he put me through. I gave him five dollars and took him back in the restaurant, back in the kitchen, you know, and fed him, you know. He actually cried, you know. Well, that gave me some... But I never brought up how mean he was to me when I was younger, you know. Well, that was one time that things turned out all right.

That was a nice little band. We used to play a little Classical music for the luncheon, you know, for the business section. We played nice, things like that. Then in the evening, when they danced, you know, we would stretch out a little bit. I'm trying to think who this guy was who played piano. I can't think of his name.
